QuestInfo.name: The Book of Ancient
QuestInfo.0: Ask Wiz the Librarian about the book you must take to Ereve.
QuestInfo.1: You must take the Book of Ancient that Wiz the Librarian told you about to Ereve.
QuestInfo.2: Is this the book Wiz the Librarian was talking about? Let's take a peek... Huh? It's unreadable!

0.0: I found this ancient tome while on my daily patrol of the library shelves. I recognized that the text on it was important, thanks to my Psychic Book-reading Powers. I contacted the Cygnus Knights at once, via carrier pigeon, of course.
0.1: I'm safeguarding the book in my Top Secret Super Safe Room. It's just over there. Please take it and deliver it to Neinheart.

yes.0:
I have to get back to my ultra-important task of reading, organizing, and shelving books, all at super sonic speeds, of course. I'll entrust this matter to you!

(Enter the secret room through the small door at the top right of the Library.)

no.0: But the world is relying on me... us! I mean, us!

1.0: (In the secret room, you find the old book that Wiz mentioned.)

npc.0: Have the book-hating gremlins got to you?! Enter the wooden door to the left of the library to enter the secret room!
